content_authority.past_paper_content: past papers/p1, past papers/p2 and past papers/p4
content_authority.official_answers_and_marks: canonical past-paper answer and mark-scheme records, including approved reconciliation records
content_authority.active_lessons: the 147 unique lesson IDs in study/topics/*/lesson-knowledge-map.json

website_mapping_authority.p1: canonical question enrichment mapping when present
website_mapping_authority.p2_p4: reviews/question-primary-lesson-mapping/{component}/{question_id}.json only when that individual record has status VALID
website_mapping_authority.canonical_enrichment_role: retained content and provenance; not authoritative for website placement when a valid reviewed lesson mapping exists
website_mapping_authority.failed_or_missing_review: use migration/mapping-overrides.json only when an explicit evidence-based development override exists; otherwise include the question with mapping_status unresolved
website_mapping_authority.override_status: development_test and review_required; an override preserves the original failed review and does not convert it to approved
website_mapping_authority.confidence: retain the record confidence; low confidence is usable for development testing but remains review_required for production

precedence: unique suffix match after removing underscores following _qNN_

selection.questions: include every readable canonical P1, P2 and P4 question record once
selection.lessons: include each active lesson once; retain redirects as aliases without duplicating retired lessons
selection.historical_lesson_folders: exclude from current website content unless referenced by an active lesson ID
